description: Policy enforcement, cost budgeting, tracing and deterministic replay for LLM agent tool calls.
Tracing and timeline visualization SDK for multi-agent LLM systems, with a CLI and FastAPI viewer.
Pluggable evaluation and regression-testing harness for LLM agents, with CI-gating on agent behavior.
Durable execution runtime for multi-step LLM agent workflows: crash-safe resume, retries, human-in-the-loop approval gates.
